import bpy,json
from pathlib import Path
source=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent/'ground15_08_weathering_revision.mcp.json'
exec(json.loads(source.read_text())['code'])
assert not craft.get('ground15_steel_revision')
N=1024;v,u=np.mgrid[0:N,0:N].astype(float)/(N-1)
rgb=np.zeros((2*N,2*N,3));height=np.zeros(rgb.shape[:2]);rough=np.zeros_like(height);metal=np.zeros_like(height)
stats=[]
for k in range(4):
 b=noise(u,v,6,8,2200+k);m=noise(u,v,32,48,2210+k);fine=noise(u,v,165,187,2220+k)
 # Weather enters from actual lower edges and joins. Broken remnants of paint
 # interrupt larger worn areas instead of leaving repeated oval stickers.
 bottom=.018+.09*b+.036*(m-.5)-v
 left=.009+.024*b+.013*(m-.5)-u
 right=u-(.981-.016*b-.013*(m-.5))
 boundary=np.maximum(bottom,np.maximum(left,right))
 # Short runs below a horizontal window/beam junction, only where water collects.
 beam=.439 if k<2 else .515
 active=sm(.47,.72,noise(u,v,8,3,2240+k))
 under=(.011+.043*b-abs(v-beam))*active-.055*(1-active)
 boundary=np.maximum(boundary,under)
 # A small set of actual panel joins carry unequal vertical corrosion.
 for j,cx in enumerate([[.115,.77],[.24,.87],[.19,.62],[.35,.85]][k]):
  active=sm(.53,.73,noise(u,v,4,11,2270+k*7+j))
  seam=(.013+.016*m-abs(u-cx))*active-.07*(1-active)
  boundary=np.maximum(boundary,seam)
 rust=sm(-.003,.006,boundary)
 # Small blue remnants give large corrosion an eroded edge at centimetre scale.
 remnant=sm(.62,.79,m)*sm(.48,.7,fine)
 rust*=1-remnant*.78
 a,h,r,mt=maps(u,v,rust,b,fine,True)
 # Warm oxide remains visibly distinct, with quieter broad value variation.
 a=a*(1-rust[:,:,None]*.18)
 sl=np.s_[(k//2)*N:(k//2+1)*N,(k%2)*N:(k%2+1)*N]
 rgb[sl]=a;height[sl]=h;rough[sl]=r;metal[sl]=mt;stats.append(float(np.mean(rust>.5)))
new=material('M15_WeatheredWallElevations',rgb,height,rough,metal,(15.8,11.0))
# Keep former wall material/UV maps as source history; use physical elevations now.
wallcount=0;capcount=0;roofmat=bpy.data.materials['M15_RoofWeatheredSteel']
for o in craft.objects:
 if o.type!='MESH' or not o.data.materials or o.data.materials[0].name!='M15_WallWeatheredSteel':continue
 o.data=o.data.copy();old=o.data.uv_layers.active;old.name='UV_PreM15Elevations';uv=o.data.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
 ps=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box];center=sum(ps,Vector())/8
 if o.name.startswith('Steel monitor cap'):
  side=0 if center.x>=0 else 1
  for li,loop in enumerate(o.data.loops):
   p=o.matrix_world@o.data.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
   uu=np.clip((p.y-2.619)/6.074,.003,.997);vv=np.clip(abs(p.x)/4.08,.003,.997)
   uv.data[li].uv=((uu+side)/2,vv)
  o.data.materials[0]=roofmat;capcount+=1
 else:
  dx=max(p.x for p in ps)-min(p.x for p in ps);dy=max(p.y for p in ps)-min(p.y for p in ps)
  sidewall=dx<dy
  tile=(2 if center.x>0 else 3) if sidewall else (0 if center.y<5.5 else 1)
  for li,loop in enumerate(o.data.loops):
   p=o.matrix_world@o.data.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
   uu=(p.y-2.6)/6.1 if sidewall else (p.x+3.95)/7.9;vv=(p.z-1.55)/5.5
   uv.data[li].uv=((np.clip(uu,.003,.997)+tile%2)/2,(np.clip(vv,.003,.997)+tile//2)/2)
  o.data.materials[0]=new;wallcount+=1
 o.data.uv_layers.active=uv;uv.active_render=True
# Tone and interrupt the main roof's very broad oxide, preserving the existing roof UV.
node=next(n for n in roofmat.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and n.image and n.image.name.endswith('_albedo'))
im=bpy.data.images.load(bpy.path.abspath(node.image.filepath),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='Non-Color';im.reload()
a=np.empty(len(im.pixels),np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(a);a=a.reshape(im.size[1],im.size[0],4);bpy.data.images.remove(im)
vh,uw=np.mgrid[0:a.shape[0],0:a.shape[1]].astype(float)/np.array([a.shape[0]-1,a.shape[1]-1])[:,None,None]
oxide=sm(.015,.085,a[:,:,0]-a[:,:,2])
grain=noise(uw,vh,170,127,2499);islands=sm(.68,.85,grain)*oxide
a[:,:,:3]*=1-oxide[:,:,None]*.13
a[:,:,:3]=a[:,:,:3]*(1-islands[:,:,None]*.62)+np.array([.282,.339,.363])*islands[:,:,None]*.62
node.image=png('M15_RoofWeatheredSteel_v2_albedo',a,True)
craft['ground15_steel_revision']=True
(cap/'steel_revision_final.json').write_text(json.dumps({'wall_elevations':wallcount,'monitor_caps':capcount,'wall_rust_fraction':stats,'original_uv_retained':True},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('M15_WEATHERING_REVISED',wallcount,capcount,stats)
